items.text: Linux viewer panes come back with the session, on the page they showed and with Home where they were opened.
On Linux the viewer's feedback button opens a composer that files the report into the worktree.
On Linux, selecting text in a viewer pane offers Quote and Copy; Quote drops the passage into the feedback composer.
Tooltips can no longer drag a background window in front of the one you are using.
The reboot-restore TUI test now checks that its app panes actually started.
